title.narrative: Protecting democracy: Mitigating and responding to Human Rights violations in Uganda.

description.narrative: Work with human rights defenders, CSOs, and line government agencies to mitigate and respond to human rights violations in Uganda.

sector.narrative: UNNGOF is a membership organisation that is a Civil Society sector leader in Democracy, Human Rights, and Governance(DRG) and has a reputation in CSO representation and collective voice. UNNGOF will be implementing the 'Protecting Democracy- mitigating and responding to human rights violations in Ugand project.

provider-org.narrative: UNNGOF is a membership organisation that provides a sharing and reflection platform for NGOs to influence development and governance processes in Uganda.

description.narrative: In collaboration with the African Institute of Investigative Journalism (AIIJ), UNNGOF will conduct training of journalists across the country. The training will equip journalists to be prepared to play key roles in advancing Human Rights throughout the election cycle.

comment.narrative: 3 regional trainings were held across the country(Gulu, Mbarara, and Jinja). The trainings were imparting skills on the role of media in advancing Human Rights, Democracy, and Elections in Uganda.

The disaggregation for the 129 journalists trained;Mbarara: 42; 10 females and 32 males.Gulu: 42; 10 females and 32 males.Jinja: 45; 20 females and 25 males.Deviation narrative: The activity was structured from 140 participants to 120 participants and from 7 regions to 3 regions. This was due to resource constraints. However, all the planned regions were covered though with lower number of participants.
